instruction: A candid family photograph in a medium shot captures a joyful indoor moment against a plain white wall. On the left, the man in the dark green long-sleeve shirt (R2) stands in profile, smiling warmly as he lifts the baby girl in the light green shirt (R1) high into the air. The baby girl (R1), wearing pink pants and a high ponytail, laughs happily while looking down at him. The man (R2) securely supports her torso with both hands, holding her aloft. The woman (R3) is absent from the scene. Soft, diffused indoor lighting fills the space, creating a bright, clean atmosphere with minimal shadows.
